mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.5% is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days, as it reflects accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates and supports equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 2.5% over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate rise above 5.0% signals economic weakness and potential recession, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 5.0%) over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in industrial production (INDPRO) and employment (PAYEMS) signals robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect between INDPRO and PAYEMS fails to produce positive returns in more than 50% of co-movement periods over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During housing boom regimes (HOUST > 1000 thousand units), strong housing starts indicate robust consumer demand and economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of housing boom periods (HOUST > 1000) over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL reading above 3.0% signals persistent inflation, prompting potential Federal Reserve tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising retail sales (RSAFS) combined with stable federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS change < 0.1%) signals strong consumer demand without monetary tightening, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of RSAFS growth and stable FEDFUNDS fails to produce positive returns in more than 50% of co-occurrence periods over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a strong labor market regime (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly), robust job creation supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of strong labor market periods (PAYEMS growth > 0.5%) over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high industrial production level (INDPRO > 110) is associated with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days, as it indicates robust manufacturing activity and economic expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO > 110 over a 5-year rolling window.
